newsitem.title: USA: Neostar gets $70 mln in DIP financing.
newsitem.headline: Neostar gets $70 mln in DIP financing.

text.p: NeoStar Retail Group Inc, parent company of Babbage's and Software Etc, Wednesday said that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Dallas entered an order granting final approval of a $70 million debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing.

NeoStar filed for Chapter 11 on September 16, 1996. NeoStar said it and its subsidiaries had sought court protection to strengthen vendor confidence to ensure adequate inventory for the upcoming holiday selling season. NeoStar received court approval for an interim DIP financing the day following its Chapter 11 filing.
NeoStar Retail Group is the nation's leading chain of consumer software specialty stores.
